scope: En Croissant finite causal preparation/continuation milestone; reused public development cohort plus constructed controls, not population accuracy or holdout validation

broad.knownExpectedFailure: known coverage gap: retain promotion through a queen-ending checking race

after.label: Clearance Preparation
after.evidence: Nb2 attacks the rook on a4 and clears c4 for a checking entry by the rook. A legal escape of the attacked piece is met by that newly opened check. Every legal reply has a connected local continuation retaining at least 180 centipawns of material, including captures of either participant, all check evasions, and an attacked-slider retreat when required. This is a bounded material certificate, not a forced mate or a whole-position evaluation; the later fork belongs to its own move.

before.label: Fork
before.evidence: c7c4 forks the king on d4 and bishop on b4. The knight on b2 protects c4, so the king cannot capture the rook. The line continues with c4b4, winning the bishop.

after.label: Trapped Knight
after.evidence: Bxg2 closes the knight's escape squares b7 and c6, while the bishop on c7 attacks it on a5. It has no safe move, including captures. A counterattack also concedes material: Bf3 is answered by Nxf3; Bh3 is answered by Bxh3. Defending it with Bb4 instead permits cxb4. Every legal defence loses material through the trapped piece, its defender or the counterattacking piece. The checked total is at least 3.2 pawns of local material, including the initial capture and losses elsewhere, not a full-position evaluation.
